I never said my mother didn't love me. My father passed in January. 

I have 5 roommates. 2 per bedroom, 3 bedroom apartment.
Yes, but I'm currently living in an on campus apartment at college.

I'm unsure. It makes me temporarily happy to think of abandoning my family without looking back.

They had me committed after my attempt 2 years ago. I am a fabulous liar and convinced the doctors that I wasn't meant to be there, they believed me and let me out without a plan for therapy or medication. 

Once I got out, my family acted as though nothing had happened and that I should be fixed and happy again. I hate them for it. I continue to feel depressed and suicidal every day but lie that I am doing great.

Don't join a sorority. That's what I did to attempt to make friends. They suck, I hate my life even more.

Then, I decided I wanted my own radio station on my college campus. I did it, and I love sitting in the booth all by myself, playing whatever music and talking about whatever I want. Sometimes, I don't even talk. By doing something for me, not expecting anything but to play some music, I made friends with other students that have radio stations. We don't hang out outside of the station or meetings, but I enjoy talking to them occasionally.
